title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Ilamathi finds footage of Ranjitham selling Paraman's jewelry and confronts her. Later, Kumaresan sees Ilamathi sleeping in the kitchen and urges Paraman to start a life with her.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Karna plots to jail Vetri and Abinaya. Meanwhile, Shanmugam explains Sudar's love for Vetri, who later receives Parvathy's diary and feeds Sudar cooked food.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Meenatchi learns that Poongodi visits each house to refute the accusations against Mayandi's family. Manjamalai misses Pechi's presence after seeing their wedding photograph.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
episodeTitle: Lakshmi's Desire for a Movie Outing
description: Lakshmi stubbornly asks for walking shoes, prompting Ragavan to mock her by giving her his old pair. When Lakshmi demands to watch a movie at the theatre, Mathi assures her.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Saravanan worries about Thangamayil's stay and breaks down to Palanivel. Though he asks her to leave, Pandian and Gomathi defend her, ordering her to stay.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: With love and blessings surrounding them, Cheran and Chandayatha happily tie the knot. The joyous wedding celebration reaches its peak with spectacular dance performances.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Muthu decides to attend Sathya's reception, planning to make a remarkable impression. Meanwhile, Vijaya reluctantly welcomes Rohini home and forbids others from helping her.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Kasthuri surprises Karthik at midnight and celebrates his birthday with joy. Later, she is shattered when he reveals his love for Priya and awaits her response on his birthday.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Indhira shares about her bike taxi job with Lakshmi. Lakshmi teases Kandhasamy over mehendi leaves, and Sarasu applies mehendi for the family while skipping herself.
